title: CampaignFigures
description: data/running/published/fundraising/<campaign-id>.json: one campaign's daily figures. Only these fields can validate, so a donor name, amount, message, Gift Aid figure or account identifier can't be written (FR-008, FR-010).

last_read_at.description: The figures were last seen to match JustGiving at this time.

points.description: At least one, sorted by date, unique per day. The last point is the current figures.

date.description: Europe/London date of the read. No time of day.

target_pence.description: Omitted when the page has no target.
